The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] established a '''government''' sometime following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Even though the government gave Hutt dealings some pretense of legitimacy, it used [[Kajidic/Legends|organized crime]] to rule like its disorganized [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|cartel predecessor]].

Despite this, the Hutts were considered a galactic power until [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] when it was pushed out of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] after being overrun during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]].
